tagline: Five games and mini courses built with three.js. Realistic detail where noticing it is the learning, restraint everywhere else.

comingSoonSummaries.lunar-field-expedition: Land at the real Apollo 15 site, read the terrain under changing sunlight, plan a sampling traverse and defend your findings.
comingSoonSummaries.object-detective: Examine artifacts under raking light, corroborate with archival records, and write an honest museum label.
comingSoonSummaries.field-ecologist: Design a sampling plan for a realistic meadow, then see the true population and how your design biased your estimate.
comingSoonSummaries.hazard-hunt: Spot warehouse hazards in realistic 3D, replay a near-miss with pause-and-decide moments, and practice reporting.
comingSoonSummaries.glacier-time-machine: Stand where a glaciologist stood in 1941, align repeat photos to real 3D terrain, and measure glacier retreat.

evaluationNote: Automated functional, accessibility and performance testing plus agent-based design reviews are complete. No real learners have tested this yet.
deviceNote: Best on a desktop or laptop browser. Phones are supported with lighter graphics.
privacyNote: This site doesn't track you. Progress is saved only in your browser.
